Dear Hiring Committee,


I am applying for the opening JR0000077640 - Gestionnaire de données at the Neuro. I believe my experience working with large scale biomedical data and  project management make me an ideal candidate for the position.

I have 3 years of experience working with large-scale health care data. In particular, I have worked with electronic health records during my training at CRCHUM. I have developed reproducible pipelines to clean, harmonize, analyse, and visualize data on vital signs and laboratory data. My postdoctoral training has allowed to gain insight into the challenges of using large-scale data, and how data needs to be managed when working with multiple team members/collaborators.

My doctoral training allowed me to develop and expertise on data collection. Because I ran and designed experiments using live specimens, much like what the researchers at the Neuro do, I learned how to transfer experiments into data, how to store the information by creating data dictionaries and reproducible analysis pipelines. On the other hand, I have ample experience working with multidisciplinary teams -including clinicians, external collaborators, statisticians, students and staff-. I have coordinated workflows and projects to achieve timely milestones in different projects during my scientific training. As a result, I have authored multiple publications during my PhD and postdoctoral training, which attest on the quality and continuity on my work with daat.

I find the mission of the Neuro important and relevant, as I can fully appreciate the importance of using diverse data sources to advance research and the associated challenges when such data need to be managed and harmonized. I believe my technical and interpersonal skills fit nicely with the role, and I welcome the opportunity to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams in an atmosphere that allows growth and intellectual challenge.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I would be delighted to further discuss my training and experience, and how I believe they align with the required skills of the Gestionnaire de données role.


Thank you for considering my application. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications further.

Sincerely,
